AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a drill in sowing? (1 mark)
   A. A weed
   B. A shallow line in the soil where seeds are sown
   C. A type of seed
   D. A power tool

2. What is transplanting? (1 mark)
   A. Making compost
   B. Moving young plants from a nursery to the field
   C. Harvesting
   D. Sowing seeds directly

3. Why is poison a bad way to deal with wild animals? (1 mark)
   A. It is too cheap
   B. It can also kill other animals and people
   C. It makes crops grow
   D. It is too slow to spread

4. What is the meaning of conserving water? (1 mark)
   A. Storing dirty water
   B. Using it carefully so none is wasted
   C. Using as much as possible
   D. Selling water

5. How should you carry scissors? (1 mark)
   A. By the blades
   B. Running
   C. With the points up
   D. With the points held down

6. Which activity is part of keeping a food journal? (1 mark)
   A. Writing what you eat at each meal
   B. Cooking only
   C. Buying food
   D. Throwing food away

7. Why does passion fruit need a trellis? (1 mark)
   A. Its stem is soft and cannot stand alone
   B. It is a tree
   C. It eats insects
   D. It grows underground

8. Which product comes from a hen? (1 mark)
   A. Eggs
   B. Honey
   C. Wool
   D. Leather

9. Which kind of PPE is suitable for handling compost? (1 mark)
   A. Shorts only
   B. A necktie
   C. Gloves and gumboots
   D. A dress only

10. Which of these is a climbing fruit crop? (1 mark)
   A. Mango
   B. Orange
   C. Guava
   D. Passion fruit

11. Which sign shows that compost is ready? (1 mark)
   A. It is grey and hard
   B. It is wet and smells sour
   C. It is dark, crumbly and smells like fresh earth
   D. It is hot and full of whole peelings

12. Where should clean PPE be stored? (1 mark)
   A. On the floor
   B. In a wet corner
   C. In a dry, clean place
   D. In a dirty box

13. About how long does compost usually take to be ready? (1 mark)
   A. Two years
   B. One day
   C. Ten minutes
   D. Two to three months

14. When is long and short tacking a good choice? (1 mark)
   A. It is never used
   B. For long straight seams where a quick hold is enough
   C. For curves only
   D. For hems on very slippery cloth

15. Which local vegetable is a protective food? (1 mark)
   A. Rice
   B. Butter
   C. Managu
   D. Ugali

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. State two safety rules when making a scarecrow. (2 marks)

17. Describe how to make a tippy tap. (4 marks)

18. Name two materials that can be used to make compost. (2 marks)

19. Explain what is wrong with a meal of ugali and salt only, and how to improve it. (3 marks)

20. Explain how to sow tiny seeds in a drill. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — A shallow line in the soil where seeds are sown
   A drill is a shallow furrow made with a stick.

2. B — Moving young plants from a nursery to the field
   Transplanting means moving seedlings.

3. B — It can also kill other animals and people
   Poison harms living things that are not the target.

4. B — Using it carefully so none is wasted
   Conserving means saving and protecting.

5. D — With the points held down
   This avoids injury.

6. A — Writing what you eat at each meal
   Records help you check your meals.

7. A — Its stem is soft and cannot stand alone
   Climbers need supports.

8. A — Eggs
   Hens lay eggs.

9. C — Gloves and gumboots
   They protect hands and feet.

10. D — Passion fruit
   Passion fruit needs support to climb.

11. C — It is dark, crumbly and smells like fresh earth
   Ready compost looks and smells like soil and the materials cannot be recognised.

12. C — In a dry, clean place
   Damp PPE grows mould.

13. D — Two to three months
   It depends on weather and materials but is usually two to three months.

14. B — For long straight seams where a quick hold is enough
   It is quicker.

15. C — Managu
   Managu is a green leafy vegetable.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ask an adult to help with sharp or heavy work; do not use wire or broken glass; wear gloves for rough poles (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Take a clean jerrican; make a small hole near the cap; hang it; tie a string from the cap to a foot lever; place a basin below and hang soap.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Vegetable peelings, dry leaves, grass, straw or animal dung (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct material.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: It only gives energy. Add beans or fish for body-building and vegetables or fruit for protective foods.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for problem, 1 for protein addition, 1 for protective addition.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: Make a shallow drill about 1 cm deep; mix seeds with sand; sprinkle thinly in the drill; cover lightly with fine soil; water gently.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four correct steps.
